===== 文件: common\rb_percpu.h =====
/* common/rb_percpu.h — per-logical-CPU 统计/槽位
 * 目标：热路径每 IO 的计数写只碰本核缓存行；HT 兄弟核不同行。
 * 读侧（查询/诊断）才做汇总，代价从写侧挪到读侧。
 * 合并自 audit 1.txt §1.1 + 2.txt §1.2，对外 API：
 *   RbPcpuFlattenIndex / RbPcpuAlloc / RbPcpuFree /
 *   RbPcpuInc / RbPcpuAdd / RbPcpuRead / RbPcpuReset */
#ifndef RB_PCPU_H
#define RB_PCPU_H

#include <ntddk.h>

#define RB_CACHELINE        64
#define RB_PCPU_MAX         256      /* 上限：多组(>64核)机器足够 */

#ifndef RB_PROC_PER_GROUP
#define RB_PROC_PER_GROUP   64       /* MAXIMUM_PROCESSORS_PER_GROUP 在部分 WDK 未导出，兜底 */
#endif

/* 一个统计量 = 一条独立缓存行数组，禁止把多个统计量塞进同一结构体相邻成员 */
typedef struct _RB_PCPU_COUNTER {
    volatile LONG64         v;                                   /* x64 上 8 字节对齐读写是原子的 */
    DECLSPEC_ALIGN(RB_CACHELINE) UINT8 _pad[RB_CACHELINE - sizeof(LONG64)];
} RB_PCPU_COUNTER, *PRB_PCPU_COUNTER;

typedef struct _RB_PCPU_SET {
    UINT32                  count;                               /* 展平后的逻辑核总数 */
    RB_PCPU_COUNTER        *slots;                               /* 指针：结构体本身单缓存行 */
} RB_PCPU_SET, *PRB_PCPU_SET;

FORCEINLINE
UINT32
RbPcpuFlattenIndex(
    _Out_opt_ PPROCESSOR_NUMBER ProcOut
    )
{
    PROCESSOR_NUMBER        n;

    KeGetCurrentProcessorNumberEx(&n);
    if (ProcOut) { *ProcOut = n; }

    /* group*每组上限 展平：Win11 多组(>64核)不撞号 */
    return (UINT32)n.Group * (UINT32)RB_PROC_PER_GROUP + (UINT32)n.Number;
}

/* 分配：NPaged 池，一次性按 count 展开。PASSIVE_LEVEL（DriverEntry 时机）调用。 */
_IRQL_requires_max_(DISPATCH_LEVEL)
FORCEINLINE
NTSTATUS
RbPcpuAlloc(
    _Out_ PRB_PCPU_SET Set
    )
{
    ULONG               cnt;
    SIZE_T              bytes;

    RtlZeroMemory(Set, sizeof(*Set));

    cnt = KeQueryActiveProcessorCountEx(ALL_PROCESSOR_GROUPS);
    if (cnt == 0) {
        return STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER;
    }
    if (cnt > RB_PCPU_MAX) {
        cnt = RB_PCPU_MAX;      /* 超上限折叠（多核共享一行，仍远好于全局单变量） */
    }

    bytes = (SIZE_T)cnt * sizeof(RB_PCPU_COUNTER);
    Set->slots = (PRB_PCPU_COUNTER)ExAllocatePool2(
                        POOL_FLAG_NON_PAGED, bytes, 'cpbR');
    if (Set->slots == NULL) {
        return STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES;
    }

    RtlZeroMemory(Set->slots, bytes);
    Set->count = cnt;
    return STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

FORCEINLINE
VOID
RbPcpuFree(
    _Inout_ PRB_PCPU_SET Set
    )
{
    /* 前提：所有写方已停（卸载路径保证） */
    if (Set->slots) {
        ExFreePoolWithTag(Set->slots, 'cpbR');
        Set->slots = NULL;
    }
    Set->count = 0;
}

/* 写侧：仅本核一行，无锁、无跨核流量。 */
FORCEINLINE
VOID
RbPcpuInc(
    _In_ PRB_PCPU_SET Set
    )
{
    UINT32 idx = RbPcpuFlattenIndex(NULL);
    if (idx < Set->count) {
        InterlockedIncrement64(&Set->slots[idx].v);
    }
}

FORCEINLINE
VOID
RbPcpuAdd(
    _In_ PRB_PCPU_SET Set,
    _In_ LONG64       Delta
    )
{
    UINT32 idx = RbPcpuFlattenIndex(NULL);
    if (idx < Set->count) {
        InterlockedAdd64(&Set->slots[idx].v, Delta);
    }
}

/* 读侧：慢路径（诊断/Query），汇总全部核。允许 ±单核增量误差。 */
FORCEINLINE
LONG64
RbPcpuRead(
    _In_ PRB_PCPU_SET Set
    )
{
    LONG64      sum = 0;
    UINT32      i;

    for (i = 0; i < Set->count; ++i) {
        sum += Set->slots[i].v;
    }
    return sum;
}

/* 清零（仅诊断复位用） */
FORCEINLINE
VOID
RbPcpuReset(
    _In_ PRB_PCPU_SET Set
    )
{
    UINT32      i;
    for (i = 0; i < Set->count; ++i) {
        Set->slots[i].v = 0;
    }
}

#endif /* RB_PCPU_H */


===== 文件: common\rb_shard.h =====
/* common/rb_shard.h — 锁分片池
 * 纪律：每把锁独占缓存行；片数覆盖全部逻辑核且为 2 的幂（用掩码取片，免除法）。
 * HT 兄弟核分到不同片，避免共享 L1/L2 的锁总线争用。 */
#ifndef RB_SHARD_H
#define RB_SHARD_H

#include <ntddk.h>
#include "rb_percpu.h"

typedef struct _RB_SHARD {
    KSPIN_LOCK              lock;
    DECLSPEC_ALIGN(RB_CACHELINE) UINT8 _pad[RB_CACHELINE - sizeof(KSPIN_LOCK)];
} RB_SHARD, *PRB_SHARD;

typedef struct _RB_SHARD_POOL {
    UINT32                  mask;               /* shardCount - 1 */
    PRB_SHARD               shards;
} RB_SHARD_POOL, *PRB_SHARD_POOL;

FORCEINLINE
NTSTATUS
RbShardPoolInit(
    _Out_ PRB_SHARD_POOL pool,
    _In_  ULONG              tag
    )
{
    UINT32                  want;
    UINT32                  pow2;
    UINT32                  i;
    USHORT                  cpus = KeQueryActiveProcessorCountEx(ALL_PROCESSOR_GROUPS);

    RtlZeroMemory(pool, sizeof(*pool));
    want = (UINT32)cpus * 2;                    /* HT：兄弟核分到不同片 */
    if (want < 16)   { want = 16; }
    if (want > 256)  { want = 256; }

    pow2 = 16;                                  /* 取 >= want 的最小 2 的幂 */
    while (pow2 < want) { pow2 <<= 1; }

    pool->shards = (PRB_SHARD)ExAllocatePool2(
        POOL_FLAG_NON_PAGED, (SIZE_T)pow2 * sizeof(RB_SHARD), tag);
    if (pool->shards == NULL) { return STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES; }

    for (i = 0; i < pow2; i++) {
        KeInitializeSpinLock(&pool->shards[i].lock);
    }
    pool->mask = pow2 - 1;
    return STATUS_SUCCESS;
}

FORCEINLINE
VOID
RbShardPoolDestroy(
    _Inout_ PRB_SHARD_POOL pool,
    _In_    ULONG            tag
    )
{
    if (pool->shards) {
        ExFreePoolWithTag(pool->shards, tag);
        pool->shards = NULL;
    }
    pool->mask = 0;
}

FORCEINLINE
UINT32
RbShardIndexOf(
    _In_ const RB_SHARD_POOL *pool,
    _In_ UINT64               hash
    )
{
    return (UINT32)(hash & (UINT64)pool->mask);
}

FORCEINLINE
KIRQL
RbShardLock(
    _In_ PRB_SHARD_POOL pool,
    _In_ UINT32             idx
    )
{
    KIRQL oldIrql;
    KeAcquireSpinLock(&pool->shards[idx].lock, &oldIrql);
    return oldIrql;
}

FORCEINLINE
VOID
RbShardUnlock(
    _In_ PRB_SHARD_POOL pool,
    _In_ UINT32             idx,
    _In_ KIRQL              oldIrql
    )
{
    KeReleaseSpinLock(&pool->shards[idx].lock, oldIrql);
}

/* DISPATCH 级路径专用：要求调用方已在 DISPATCH_LEVEL，用错直接 BSOD，勿混用 */
FORCEINLINE
VOID
RbShardLockAtDpc(
    _In_ PRB_SHARD_POOL pool,
    _In_ UINT32             idx
    )
{
    KeAcquireSpinLockAtDpcLevel(&pool->shards[idx].lock);
}

FORCEINLINE
VOID
RbShardUnlockFromDpc(
    _In_ PRB_SHARD_POOL pool,
    _In_ UINT32             idx
    )
{
    KeReleaseSpinLockFromDpcLevel(&pool->shards[idx].lock);
}

#endif /* RB_SHARD_H */


===== 文件: common\rb_alloc.h =====
/* common/rb_alloc.h — Win10 2004+ 用 ExAllocatePool2（强制 Nx）；更老版本回退 */
#ifndef RB_ALLOC_H
#define RB_ALLOC_H
#include <ntddk.h>

#if (NTDDI_VERSION >= NTDDI_WIN10_VB)
#  define RB_ALLOC(bytes, tag) ExAllocatePool2(POOL_FLAG_NON_PAGED, (bytes), (tag))
#else
#  define RB_ALLOC(bytes, tag) ExAllocatePoolWithTag(NonPagedPoolNx, (bytes), (tag))
#endif
#define RB_FREE(p, tag)      do { if (p) { ExFreePoolWithTag((p), (tag)); (p) = NULL; } } while (0)
#endif /* RB_ALLOC_H */


===== 文件: common\rb_threadsched.h =====
/* common/rb_threadsched.h
 * HT/组感知的工作线程排布：把辅助线程绑定到"与主 IO 核不同物理核"的逻辑核上，
 * 避免 flush/writeback 线程与 IO 路径 DPC 抢同一物理核。
 * 失败/信息不可得 → 不绑定，退回系统默认（绝不因优化失败阻断启动）。 */
#ifndef RB_THREADSCHED_H
#define RB_THREADSCHED_H

#include <ntddk.h>
#include "rb_percpu.h"

typedef struct _RB_AFFIN_TARGET {
    GROUP_AFFINITY  ga;         /* 目标组亲和 */
    BOOLEAN         valid;
} RB_AFFIN_TARGET, *PRB_AFFIN_TARGET;

/*
 * RbPickAuxTargets:
 *   Targets   — 调用方提供数组（容量 RB_PCPU_MAX）
 *   TargetCnt — 实际写入个数
 *   AuxCount  — 需要几个辅助线程槽位
 * 返回选中的逻辑核列表；每个目标尽量落在不同物理核。
 */
_IRQL_requires_max_(PASSIVE_LEVEL)
FORCEINLINE
NTSTATUS
RbPickAuxTargets(
    _Out_writes_to_(RB_PCPU_MAX, *TargetCnt) RB_AFFIN_TARGET *Targets,
    _Out_ ULONG *TargetCnt,
    _In_  ULONG  AuxCount
    )
{
    NTSTATUS                        status;
    ULONG                           i, n, coreInfoSize;
    SYSTEM_LOGICAL_PROCESSOR_INFORMATION_EX *info = NULL;
    ULONG                           picked = 0;
    static UCHAR                    usedPerCore[RB_PCPU_MAX];

    *TargetCnt = 0;
    RtlZeroMemory(Targets, sizeof(RB_AFFIN_TARGET) * RB_PCPU_MAX);
    RtlZeroMemory(usedPerCore, sizeof(usedPerCore));

    n = KeQueryActiveProcessorCountEx(ALL_PROCESSOR_GROUPS);
    if (n == 0 || n > RB_PCPU_MAX) { n = RB_PCPU_MAX; }

    /* 取物理核拓扑 */
    coreInfoSize = 0;
    status = KeQueryLogicalProcessorRelationship(
                 NULL, RelationProcessorCore, NULL, &coreInfoSize);
    if (status == STATUS_INFO_LENGTH_MISMATCH && coreInfoSize > 0) {
        info = (SYSTEM_LOGICAL_PROCESSOR_INFORMATION_EX *)
               ExAllocatePool2(POOL_FLAG_NON_PAGED, coreInfoSize, 'hpbR');
        if (info) {
            status = KeQueryLogicalProcessorRelationship(
                         NULL, RelationProcessorCore, info, &coreInfoSize);
            if (!NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
                ExFreePoolWithTag(info, 'hpbR');
                info = NULL;
            }
        }
    }
    /* info 可为 NULL：拓扑不可得时走朴素轮选 */

    for (i = 0; i < n && picked < AuxCount && picked < RB_PCPU_MAX; ++i) {
        PROCESSOR_NUMBER    pn;
        ULONG               coreId = i;   /* 无拓扑时退化：索引即核 id */
        BOOLEAN             skip = FALSE;

        KeGetProcessorNumberFromIndex(i, &pn);

        if (info) {
            ULONG               off = 0;
            SYSTEM_LOGICAL_PROCESSOR_INFORMATION_EX *rec;
            while (off < coreInfoSize) {
                rec = (SYSTEM_LOGICAL_PROCESSOR_INFORMATION_EX *)
                      ((PUCHAR)info + off);
                if (rec->Relationship == RelationProcessorCore) {
                    GROUP_AFFINITY *ga = &rec->Processor.GroupMask[0];
                    if (ga->Group == pn.Group &&
                        (ga->Mask & (KAFFINITY)(1ull << pn.Number))) {
                        coreId = (ULONG)(uintptr_t)rec;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                off += rec->Size;
            }
        }

        if (usedPerCore[coreId % RB_PCPU_MAX] > 0) {
            skip = TRUE;
        }
        if (!skip) {
            usedPerCore[coreId % RB_PCPU_MAX] = 1;
            Targets[picked].ga.Group       = pn.Group;
            Targets[picked].ga.Mask        = (KAFFINITY)(1ull << pn.Number);
            Targets[picked].ga.Reserved[0] = 0;
            Targets[picked].ga.Reserved[1] = 0;
            Targets[picked].ga.Reserved[2] = 0;
            Targets[picked].valid = TRUE;
            ++picked;
        }
    }

    if (info) {
        ExFreePoolWithTag(info, 'hpbR');
    }

    *TargetCnt = picked;
    return (picked > 0) ? STATUS_SUCCESS : STATUS_UNSUCCESSFUL;
}

/* 绑定：在线程入口（PsCreateSystemThread 之后、工作循环之前）调用一次 */
_IRQL_requires_max_(PASSIVE_LEVEL)
FORCEINLINE
VOID
RbBindCurrentThreadToTarget(
    _In_ const RB_AFFIN_TARGET *Target
    )
{
    if (Target && Target->valid) {
        KeSetSystemGroupAffinityThread((PGROUP_AFFINITY)&Target->ga, NULL);
    }
}

#endif /* RB_THREADSCHED_H */


===== 文件: common\rb_shardlock.h =====
/* common/rb_shardlock.h — 64 片锁模板
 * N = 2^k，用"指针哈希"选片，保证同一条目永远落同片（无迁移一致性）。
 * 用法：RbShardLockAcquire(&L, key); ... RbShardLockRelease(&L, key);
 * 替换全局 KeAcquireSpinLock 处：key 传条目指针或其 hash 源。
 * 守则：同临界区多条目必须用同一把 key；遍历全表按片号递增取、逆序放；
 *       跨结构全局不变量保持原锁。 */
#ifndef RB_SHARDLOCK_H
#define RB_SHARDLOCK_H

#include <ntddk.h>

#define RB_SHARD_BITS   6
#define RB_SHARD_COUNT  (1u << RB_SHARD_BITS)     /* 64 片，可按需改 */

typedef struct _RB_SHARD_LOCK {
    KSPIN_LOCK  locks[RB_SHARD_COUNT];
} RB_SHARD_LOCK, *PRB_SHARD_LOCK;

FORCEINLINE
VOID
RbShardLockInit(
    _Out_ PRB_SHARD_LOCK L
    )
{
    ULONG i;
    for (i = 0; i < RB_SHARD_COUNT; ++i) {
        KeInitializeSpinLock(&L->locks[i]);
    }
}

FORCEINLINE
ULONG
RbShardIndexOf(
    _In_ const VOID *Key        /* 条目指针；或预先折叠好的 ULONG hash */
    )
{
    ULONG_PTR v = (ULONG_PTR)Key;
    v ^= v >> 17;
    v *= (ULONG_PTR)0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull;
    return (ULONG)((v >> 24) & (RB_SHARD_COUNT - 1));
}

FORCEINLINE
VOID
RbShardLockAcquire(
    _Inout_ PRB_SHARD_LOCK L,
    _In_    const VOID    *Key,
    _Out_   KIRQL         *OldIrql
    )
{
    KeAcquireSpinLock(&L->locks[RbShardIndexOf(Key)], OldIrql);
}

FORCEINLINE
VOID
RbShardLockRelease(
    _Inout_ PRB_SHARD_LOCK L,
    _In_    const VOID    *Key,
    _In_    KIRQL          OldIrql
    )
{
    KeReleaseSpinLock(&L->locks[RbShardIndexOf(Key)], OldIrql);
}

#endif /* RB_SHARDLOCK_H */


===== 文件: common\rb_wiring.h =====
/* common/rb_wiring.h — 接线总表（构建期事实，替代注释性"未接线"标注）
 * 0 = 已实现但未接入调用链（审计 RB-Rev-V10.3.4 WB-1 / 第10章确认的 OFF 状态）
 * 1 = 已接线。纪律：一格 commit 只允许翻转一个开关。 */
#ifndef RB_WIRING_H
#define RB_WIRING_H

#define RB_WIRED_WBCOAL        0   /* rbwback.c : RbWbInit/RbWbStop 接挂载/停机 */
#define RB_WIRED_L2_ON_EVICT   0   /* rbfeat.c  : RbFeatOnEvict 接 core 淘汰路径  */

#if RB_WIRED_WBCOAL && RB_WIRED_L2_ON_EVICT
#  error "wire ONE feature per commit: finish WBCOAL wiring first"
#endif

/* 消费点约定（门禁 check_repo.py 强制校验）：
 *   任何调用 RbWbInit/RbWbStop 的文件，必须含 "#if RB_WIRED_WBCOAL" 守卫；
 *   任何调用 RbFeatOnEvict 的文件，必须含 "#if RB_WIRED_L2_ON_EVICT" 守卫；
 *   RB_WIRED_* 只准在本文件定义，他处 #define 视为 FAIL。 */
#endif /* RB_WIRING_H */


===== 文件: core\cache.c (关键段：percpu flush 统计 + evict_victim 锁序) =====
--- percpu flush 统计（约 :68-88）---
 * IMPORTANT: this does NOT touch synchronization state — zflush_cnt gate,
 * flush_active gate, and c->dseq[] version tags remain plain atomic/global. */
typedef struct _RB_FLUSH_COUNTERS {
    long long dseq;        /* times a per-sub dirty-generation was bumped */
    long long sflush;      /* serial flush critical-section entries */
    long long zflush;      /* zoned flush critical-section entries */
    long long flush_pass;  /* flush_pass() invocations */
} RB_FLUSH_COUNTERS;
#ifdef RB_KERNEL_BUILD
  #include "../common/rb_percpu.h"   /* driver side provides this header */
  typedef struct _RB_PCPU_FLUSH {
      DECLSPEC_ALIGN(RB_CACHELINE) RB_FLUSH_COUNTERS c;
      unsigned char _pad[RB_CACHELINE - sizeof(RB_FLUSH_COUNTERS)];
  } RB_PCPU_FLUSH;
  static RB_PCPU_FLUSH *g_flush_pcpu = NULL;   /* allocated at driver init */
  static unsigned int   g_flush_pcpu_n = 0;
  #define RB_FLUSH_STAT_INC(f) do{                                     \
      unsigned int _i = RbPcpuFlattenIndex(NULL);                      \
      if(g_flush_pcpu && _i < g_flush_pcpu_n)                           \
          InterlockedIncrement64(&g_flush_pcpu[_i].c.f);               \
  }while(0)
#else
  static RB_FLUSH_COUNTERS g_flush_stat;   /* one slot == whole sum */
  #define RB_FLUSH_STAT_INC(f) InterlockedIncrement64(&g_flush_stat.f)
#endif

--- evict_victim 锁序修正（约 :1392-1410，锁内摘链锁外回调）---
    }
    RB_RW_UNLOCK(&s->stripes[k]);
#if RB_WIRED_L2_ON_EVICT
    /* 锁内摘链、锁外回调：避免 RbFeatOnEvict 内部再取同层锁导致锁序倒置死锁 */
    if(have_evict) RbFeatOnEvict(evict_key, evict_seq);
#endif
    return r;
}
static void stream_reclaim(rb_stream *s)
{
    rb_engine *eng=s->eng;
    rb_u64 ch_,hi_,lo_;
    struct rb_evict_vic vics[RB_EVICT_BATCH];
    rb_effective_caps(eng,&ch_,&hi_,&lo_);
    if(!RC_TRY(s))return;
    while(RB_ALOAD64(&eng->total_bytes)>lo_){
        int n=evict_select(s,vics,RB_EVICT_BATCH), i, freed=0;
        if(n==0)break;
        for(i=0;i<n;i++) freed += (evict_victim(s,vics[i].start,vics[i].epoch)==1);
        if(!freed)break;   /* no progress: chunks gone/dirty, avoid livelock */
    }
    if(RB_ALOAD64(&eng->total_bytes)>hi_){
        flush_stream(s,0);

===== 文件: ui\controller\RAMBlockCache.Controller\Controls\Sparkline.cs =====
using System;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Shapes;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Controls;

public sealed class Sparkline : FrameworkElement
{
    public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueProperty = DependencyProperty.Register(
        nameof(Value), typeof(double), typeof(Sparkline),
        new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));
    public static readonly DependencyProperty CapacityProperty = DependencyProperty.Register(
        nameof(Capacity), typeof(int), typeof(Sparkline),
        new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(30, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));
    public static readonly DependencyProperty StrokeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register(
        nameof(Stroke), typeof(Color), typeof(Sparkline),
        new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(Color.FromRgb(0x60, 0xCD, 0xFF), FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsRender));

    public double Value { get => (double)GetValue(ValueProperty); set => SetValue(ValueProperty, value); }
    public int Capacity { get => (int)GetValue(CapacityProperty); set => SetValue(CapacityProperty, value); }
    public Color Stroke { get => (Color)GetValue(StrokeProperty); set => SetValue(StrokeProperty, value); }

    private readonly double[] _ring = new double[30];
    private int _head, _count;

    public Sparkline() { Loaded += (_, _) => Push(Value); }

    protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
    {
        base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
        if (e.Property == ValueProperty) Push(Value);
    }

    private void Push(double v)
    {
        _ring[_head] = v;
        _head = (_head + 1) % _ring.Length;
        _count = Math.Min(_count + 1, _ring.Length);
        InvalidateVisual();
    }

    protected override void OnRender(DrawingContext dc)
    {
        if (_count < 2) return;
        double w = ActualWidth, h = ActualHeight;
        double max = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < _count; i++) max = Math.Max(max, _ring[i]);
        var pen = new Pen(new SolidColorBrush(Stroke), 1.6);
        pen.Freeze();
        var geo = new StreamGeometry();
        using (var ctx = geo.Open())
        {
            bool first = true;
            for (int i = 0; i < _count; i++)
            {
                int idx = (_head - _count + i + _ring.Length) % _ring.Length;
                double x = w * i / (_count - 1);
                double y = h - h * (_ring[idx] / max) * 0.92 - 2;
                if (first) { ctx.BeginFigure(new Point(x, y), false, false); first = false; }
                else ctx.LineTo(new Point(x, y), true, false);
            }
        }
        geo.Freeze();
        dc.DrawGeometry(null, pen, geo);
    }
}


===== 文件: ui\controller\RAMBlockCache.Controller\Helpers\RelayCommand.cs =====
using System;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows.Input;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Helpers;

public abstract class ObservableObject : INotifyPropertyChanged
{
    public event PropertyChangedEventHandler? PropertyChanged;
    protected void RaisePropertyChanged([CallerMemberName] string? n = null)
        => PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(n));
    protected bool Set<T>(ref T field, T value, [CallerMemberName] string? n = null)
    {
        if (Equals(field, value)) return false;
        field = value; RaisePropertyChanged(n); return true;
    }
}

public sealed class RelayCommand : ICommand
{
    private readonly Action _exec;
    private readonly Func<bool>? _can;
    public RelayCommand(Action exec, Func<bool>? can = null) { _exec = exec; _can = can; }
    public bool CanExecute(object? p) => _can?.Invoke() ?? true;
    public void Execute(object? p) => _exec();
    public event EventHandler? CanExecuteChanged
    { add => CommandManager.RequerySuggested += value; remove => CommandManager.RequerySuggested -= value; }
}

public sealed class AsyncRelayCommand : ICommand
{
    private readonly Func<Task> _exec;
    private readonly Func<bool>? _can;
    private bool _busy;
    public AsyncRelayCommand(Func<Task> exec, Func<bool>? can = null) { _exec = exec; _can = can; }
    public bool CanExecute(object? p) => !_busy && (_can?.Invoke() ?? true);
    public async void Execute(object? p)
    {
        if (!CanExecute(p)) return;
        _busy = true; CommandManager.InvalidateRequerySuggested();
        try { await _exec(); }
        catch (Exception ex) { Services.LogService.Error($"命令执行异常：{ex.Message}"); }
        finally { _busy = false; CommandManager.InvalidateRequerySuggested(); }
    }
    public event EventHandler? CanExecuteChanged
    { add => CommandManager.RequerySuggested += value; remove => CommandManager.RequerySuggested -= value; }
}


===== 文件: ui\controller\RAMBlockCache.Controller\Models\DriverException.cs =====
using System;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Models;

public sealed class DriverException : Exception
{
    public int Win32Error { get; }

    public DriverException(int win32Error, string context)
        : base($"{context}（{Describe(win32Error)}）") => Win32Error = win32Error;

    private static string Describe(int e) => e switch
    {
        2    => "设备未就绪，驱动未加载或该卷未挂载",
        5    => "拒绝访问，请以管理员身份运行控制器",
        31   => "驱动侧设备故障，请检查驱动日志",
        87   => "参数非法，控制器与驱动协议版本不一致",
        170  => "驱动忙，正在重试",
        1219 => "多次凭据冲突",
        _    => $"Win32 错误 {e}"
    };
}


===== 文件: ui\controller\RAMBlockCache.Controller\Models\Models.cs =====
using System;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Models;

// ============================================================================
// 真实协议层（ctl/rb_proto.h, Protocol 9）—— 单一 IOCTL 0x222000 + RB_MSG.Type 分发。
// 旧 ui/wpf/RbClient 已验证此布局能连上正在运行的 Build 17 驱动，逐字段对齐照抄。
//   消息头: Type@0(u32) / Size@4(u32) / Status@8(i32, NTSTATUS) / Reserved@12(u32)
//   联合体 Data@16，整块 RbMsgSize = 7704 字节。
// ============================================================================
public static class RbP
{
    public const uint IOCTL_RB_REQUEST = 0x00222000;

    public const uint GET_STATS = 1;
    public const uint SET_CONFIG = 2;
    public const uint FLUSH = 3;
    public const uint GET_CONFIG = 4;
    public const uint EXIT_SAFE_MODE = 5;
    public const uint SET_VOLUME = 6;
    public const uint GET_VOLUMES = 7;
    public const uint ATTACH_VOLUME = 8;
    public const uint GET_LOG = 9;
    public const uint GET_VERSION = 10;
    public const uint PANIC = 11;
    public const uint PANIC_CLEAR = 12;

    public const int DataOffset = 16;
    public const int MsgSize = 7704;

    public const int MaxVolumes = 8;
    public const int Stripes = 64;
    public const int NameLen = 16;

    public const uint WM_THROUGH = 0;
    public const uint WM_BACK = 1;
    public const uint WM_GLOBAL = 2;
}

// ---------------- 真实内核结构（Pack=8，逐字段对齐） ----------------

[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 8)]
public struct RbStats
{
    public ulong ReadReq, ReadHit, ReadBytes, ReadHitBytes;
    public ulong WriteReq, WriteBytes, WriteCached, WbFlush, WbBytes, EvictBytes;
    public ulong CurBytes, DirtyBytes, ChunkCount;
    public uint InstanceCount, CacheSizeMB, EffectiveCacheMB, WriteBackMode, Enabled, SafeMode, RmwReads, TrimCount;
    public ulong IdleReclaimBytes, LostDirtyBytes;
    [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValArray, SizeConst = RbP.Stripes)] public ulong[] StripeRead;
    [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValArray, SizeConst = RbP.Stripes)] public ulong[] StripeWrite;
    public uint StripeCount;
    public uint PressureLevel, DynamicLimitMB;
    public ulong AvailablePhysMB, PeakBytes, ReadaheadBytes, ReadaheadHitBytes, PressureShrinkBytes;
    public uint ReadaheadActive;
    public uint PanicActive, BootFails, DirtySnapshotMB;
}

[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 8)]
public struct RbVolumeInfo
{
    public ushort Letter;
    public uint Attached, ReadEnabled, WriteEnabled, IsSystem;
    public ulong CapacityMB, FreeMB;
    public uint Bound, WriteMode, LogicalSectorBytes, PhysicalSectorBytes;
}

[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 8)]
public struct RbVolumeList
{
    public uint Count;
    [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValArray, SizeConst = RbP.MaxVolumes)] public RbVolumeInfo[] Items;
}

[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 8)]
public struct RbVolumeAttach
{
    public ushort Letter;
    public uint Attach, ReadEnabled, WriteEnabled, WriteMode;
}

[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 8)]
public struct RbConfigNative
{
    public uint Enabled, ReadCacheEnabled, WriteCacheEnabled, WriteBack;
    public uint CacheSizeMB, FlushIntervalMs, DirtyHighPct, DirtyLowPct;
    public uint SystemVolumeCached, IdleReclaimEnabled, IdleReclaimSec, ParallelFlush;
    public uint CachePagingIo, WriteRelease, Frozen, IdleFlush;
    [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValArray, SizeConst = RbP.MaxVolumes * 4)] public ushort[] VolumeFilter;
    public uint ReadaheadEnabled, ReadaheadWindowKB, AutoMemory, MemReserveMB, AutoUsePct, BlockSize;
}

[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 8)]
public struct RbVersionNative
{
    public uint ProtocolVersion, Major, Minor, Build, IsBlockFilter, Reserved;
    public ulong DriverFlags;
    [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValArray, SizeConst = RbP.NameLen)] public ushort[] Name;
}

public struct RbVersion

}

}

    public uint Mounted;

    public ulong ReadBytes, WriteBytes;
    public ulong ReadHits, ReadMisses, WriteHits, WriteMisses;

}

    public uint Reserved;
    [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValArray, SizeConst = 26)] public RbVolumeStats[] V;
}

/// <summary>CachePage 提交的小配置（只映射驱动支持的 WriteBack / FlushIntervalMs）。</summary>
public struct RbConfig
{
    public uint DefaultCacheMB;
    public uint FlushIntervalMs;
    public uint WriteMode;       // 1=回写 2=直写
    public uint EvictPolicy;
    public uint MaxTotalCacheMB;
}

public static class Conv
{
    public const ulong KB = 1024, MB = 1024 * 1024, GB = 1024UL * 1024 * 1024;

    public static string Size(ulong b)
    {
        return b >= GB ? $"{(double)b / GB:F2} GB"
             : b >= MB ? $"{(double)b / MB:F1} MB"
             : b >= KB ? $"{(double)b / KB:F1} KB"
             : $"{b} B";
    }
    public static string Rate(double bytesPerSec) => bytesPerSec <= 0 ? "0 B/s" : Size((ulong)bytesPerSec) + "/s";
}


===== 文件: ui\controller\RAMBlockCache.Controller\Services\DriverService.cs =====
using System;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Win32.SafeHandles;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Models;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;

// 写模式常量（与文档 ViewModel 引用一致）
internal static class Rb
{
    public const uint ModeWriteThrough = 0;
    public const uint ModeWriteBack    = 1;
}

// —— 真实驱动 ctl/rb_proto.h 的 C# 镜像（Pack=8，偏移冻结）——
[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 8)]
internal struct RbVersion
{
    public uint ProtocolVersion, Major, Minor, Build, IsBlockFilter, Reserved;
    public ulong DriverFlags;
    [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValArray, SizeConst = 16)] public char[] Name;
}

[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 8)]
internal struct RbStats
{
    public ulong ReadReq, ReadHit, ReadBytes, ReadHitBytes;
    public ulong WriteReq, WriteBytes, WriteCached, WbFlush, WbBytes;
    public ulong EvictBytes, CurBytes, DirtyBytes, ChunkCount;
    public uint InstanceCount, CacheSizeMB, EffectiveCacheMB, WriteBackMode;
    public uint Enabled, SafeMode, RmwReads, TrimCount;
    public ulong IdleReclaimBytes, LostDirtyBytes;
    [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValArray, SizeConst = 64)] public ulong[] StripeRead;
    [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValArray, SizeConst = 64)] public ulong[] StripeWrite;
    public uint StripeCount, PressureLevel, DynamicLimitMB;
    public ulong AvailablePhysMB, PeakBytes, ReadaheadBytes, ReadaheadHitBytes, PressureShrinkBytes;
    public uint ReadaheadActive, PanicActive, BootFails, DirtySnapshotMB;
}

[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 8)]
internal struct RbVolumeItem
{
    public char Letter;
    public uint Attached, ReadEnabled, WriteEnabled, IsSystem;
    public ulong CapacityMB, FreeMB;
    public uint Bound, WriteMode, LogicalSectorBytes, PhysicalSectorBytes;
}

[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 8)]
internal struct RbVolumeList
{
    public uint Count;
    [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValArray, SizeConst = 8)] public RbVolumeItem[] Items;
}

[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 8)]
internal struct RbAttach
{
    public char Letter;
    public uint Attach, ReadEnabled, WriteEnabled, WriteMode;
}

[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 8)]
internal struct RbVolumeSet
{
    public char Letter;
    public uint ReadEnabled, WriteEnabled, WriteMode;
}

/// <summary>每卷状态快照（供文档 StatsService 消费）。</summary>
public struct StatusOutput
{
    public ulong DeviceKey;
    public ulong ReadHits, ReadMisses, WriteHits, WriteMisses;
    public ulong BytesFromCache, BytesFromDisk;
    public ulong DirtyBlocks, Evictions, FlushErrors;
    public ulong CacheBytesUsed, CacheBytesTotal;
    public uint Mounted, Mode, Paused;
}

public sealed class DriverService : IDisposable
{
    public static DriverService Instance { get; } = new();
    private DriverService() { }

    // FIX-4：与驱动 version.h 对齐的编译期契约
    private const int ExpectedProtocol    = 9;
    private const string ExpectedDriverVer = "V10.3.4 Build 17";
    /// <summary>驱动读回版本，供 UI 展示。</summary>
    public string DriverVersion { get; private set; } = "unknown";

    private const string DevicePath = @"\\.\RAMBlockCache";
    private const uint IOCTL_RB_REQUEST = 0x00222000;
    private const int BufSize = 7704;

    // 消息号（ctl/rb_proto.h）
    private const uint MSG_GET_STATS = 1, MSG_SET_CONFIG = 2, MSG_FLUSH = 3,
        MSG_GET_CONFIG = 4, MSG_SET_VOLUME = 6, MSG_GET_VOLUMES = 7,
        MSG_ATTACH_VOLUME = 8, MSG_GET_VERSION = 10;

    private SafeFileHandle? _h;
    private readonly object _gate = new();

    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true, CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)]
    private static extern SafeFileHandle CreateFileW(string name, uint access, uint share,
        IntPtr security, uint disposition, uint flags, IntPtr template);

    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
    [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
    private static extern bool DeviceIoControl(SafeFileHandle h, uint ioctl,
        IntPtr inBuf, uint inSize, IntPtr outBuf, uint outSize, out uint returned, IntPtr overlap);

    private SafeFileHandle Handle
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                if (_h is { IsInvalid: false, IsClosed: false }) return _h;
                var h = CreateFileW(DevicePath, 0x80000000 /*GENERIC_READ*/, 3,
                    IntPtr.Zero, 3 /*OPEN_EXISTING*/, 0, IntPtr.Zero);
                if (h.IsInvalid)
                    throw new DriverException(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error(), "无法打开设备 \\\\.\\RAMBlockCache（驱动未加载或未以管理员运行）");
                _h = h;
                return h;
            }
        }
    }

    private void Roundtrip(uint type, object? payload, IntPtr p)
    {
        Marshal.WriteInt32(p, 0, (int)type);
        Marshal.WriteInt32(p, 4, BufSize);
        Marshal.WriteInt32(p, 8, 0);
        Marshal.WriteInt32(p, 12, 0);
        if (payload != null) Marshal.StructureToPtr(payload, p + 16, false);
        if (!DeviceIoControl(Handle, IOCTL_RB_REQUEST, p, (uint)BufSize, p, (uint)BufSize, out _, IntPtr.Zero))
            throw new DriverException(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error(), $"IOCTL 0x{IOCTL_RB_REQUEST:X} 消息 {type} 失败");
        int st = Marshal.ReadInt32(p, 8);
        if (st < 0) throw new DriverException(st, $"驱动返回错误 0x{(uint)st:X8}（消息 {type}）");
    }

    private TOut Query<TOut>(uint type, object? payload) where TOut : struct
    {
        IntPtr p = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(BufSize);
        try
        {
            Roundtrip(type, payload, p);
            return Marshal.PtrToStructure<TOut>(p + 16)!;
        }
        finally { Marshal.FreeHGlobal(p); }
    }

    public (uint protocol, uint build) Negotiate()
    {
        var ver = Query<RbVersion>(MSG_GET_VERSION, null);
        DriverVersion = $"{ver.Major}.{ver.Minor} Build{ver.Build}";
        LogService.Info($"驱动版本 {DriverVersion} Protocol{ver.ProtocolVersion}");
        if (ver.ProtocolVersion != ExpectedProtocol)
            throw new DriverException(87, $"协议不匹配：驱动 v{ver.ProtocolVersion}，控制台 v{ExpectedProtocol}，拒绝连接");
        if (DriverVersion != ExpectedDriverVer)
            LogService.Warn($"驱动版本 {DriverVersion} 与 UI 期望 {ExpectedDriverVer} 不同（协议一致，软校验放行）");
        return (ver.ProtocolVersion, ver.Build);
    }

    public async Task<ulong> MountAsync(ulong deviceKey, uint cacheBytes, uint mode)
    {
        char letter = SystemService.LetterFromKey(deviceKey);
        var att = new RbAttach { Letter = letter, Attach = 1, ReadEnabled = 1, WriteEnabled = 1, WriteMode = mode };
        for (int attempt = 0; ; attempt++)
        {
            try { Query<RbAttach>(MSG_ATTACH_VOLUME, att); return cacheBytes; }
            catch (DriverException ex) when (IsTransientAttach(ex) && attempt < 3)
            { await Task.Delay(300 * (attempt + 1)).ConfigureAwait(false); }
            catch (DriverException ex)
            {
                // FIX-4b：确定性拒绝（0x5 ACCESS_DENIED / panic / L2 / 负 NTSTATUS）不重试
                if (ex.Win32Error == 5 || ex.Win32Error < 0)
                    LogService.Error($"{letter}: 驱动确定性拒绝 attach（{ex.Win32Error}），不再重试，请检查 panic/保护状态");
                throw;
            }
        }
    }

    public void Unmount(ulong deviceKey)
    {
        char letter = SystemService.LetterFromKey(deviceKey);
        try { Query<RbAttach>(MSG_FLUSH, null); } catch { }
        Query<RbAttach>(MSG_ATTACH_VOLUME, new RbAttach { Letter = letter, Attach = 0, ReadEnabled = 1, WriteEnabled = 1, WriteMode = 2 });
    }

    public StatusOutput QueryStats(ulong deviceKey)
    {
        char letter = SystemService.LetterFromKey(deviceKey);
        var s = Query<RbStats>(MSG_GET_STATS, null);
        var list = Query<RbVolumeList>(MSG_GET_VOLUMES, null);
        uint attached = 0, wmode = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < list.Count && i < 8; i++)
        {
            if (char.ToUpperInvariant(list.Items[i].Letter) == char.ToUpperInvariant(letter))
            { attached = list.Items[i].Attached; wmode = list.Items[i].WriteMode; break; }
        }
        ulong miss = s.ReadReq > s.ReadHit ? s.ReadReq - s.ReadHit : 0;
        ulong wmiss = s.WriteReq > s.WriteCached ? s.WriteReq - s.WriteCached : 0;
        ulong diskBytes = s.ReadBytes > s.ReadHitBytes ? s.ReadBytes - s.ReadHitBytes : 0;
        return new StatusOutput
        {
            DeviceKey = deviceKey,
            ReadHits = s.ReadHit, ReadMisses = miss,
            WriteHits = s.WriteCached, WriteMisses = wmiss,
            BytesFromCache = s.ReadHitBytes, BytesFromDisk = diskBytes,
            DirtyBlocks = s.DirtyBytes / 4096, Evictions = s.EvictBytes / 4096, FlushErrors = 0,
            CacheBytesUsed = s.CurBytes,
            CacheBytesTotal = (ulong)s.EffectiveCacheMB * 1048576,
            Mounted = attached, Mode = wmode, Paused = 0
        };
    }

    public ulong SetQuota(ulong deviceKey, ulong cacheBytes)
    {
        // 真实驱动无逐卷配额；全局缓存为动态自适应，这里回读为期望值。
        LogService.Info($"{SystemService.LetterFromKey(deviceKey)} 配额（驱动动态自适应，不下发）");
        return cacheBytes;
    }

    public void Flush(ulong deviceKey) { Query<RbAttach>(MSG_FLUSH, null); }

    public void Pause(ulong deviceKey)  { LogService.Warn("驱动不支持逐卷暂停，已忽略"); }
    public void Resume(ulong deviceKey) { LogService.Warn("驱动不支持逐卷暂停，已忽略"); }

    public void SetMode(ulong deviceKey, uint mode)
    {
        char letter = SystemService.LetterFromKey(deviceKey);
        Query<RbVolumeSet>(MSG_SET_VOLUME,
            new RbVolumeSet { Letter = letter, ReadEnabled = 1, WriteEnabled = 1, WriteMode = mode });
    }

    // 仅"瞬时冲突"才退避重试；0x5 与负 NTSTATUS(驱动 Status)为确定性拒绝
    private static bool IsTransientAttach(DriverException ex) =>
        ex.Win32Error == 170 /*BUSY*/ || ex.Win32Error == 2 /*未就绪*/;

    public void Dispose() { lock (_gate) { _h?.Dispose(); _h = null; } }
}


===== 文件: ui\controller\RAMBlockCache.Controller\Services\LogService.cs =====
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;

public static class LogService
{
    private static readonly object Gate = new();
    private static readonly string Dir = Path.Combine(
        Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.CommonApplicationData), "RAMBlockCache", "logs");
    private const int RingSize = 500;
    private static readonly Queue<string> Ring = new(RingSize);

    public static event Action<string>? Appended;

    public static void Info(string msg)  => Write("INFO ", msg);
    public static void Warn(string msg)  => Write("WARN ", msg);
    public static void Error(string msg) => Write("ERROR", msg);

    private static void Write(string lvl, string msg)
    {
        var line = $"{DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff} [{lvl}] {msg}";
        lock (Gate)
        {
            Ring.Enqueue(line);
            while (Ring.Count > RingSize) Ring.Dequeue();
        }
        Appended?.Invoke(line);
        try
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Dir);
            System.IO.File.AppendAllText(Path.Combine(Dir, $"ctrl-{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd}.log"), line + Environment.NewLine);
        }
        catch { }
    }

    public static IReadOnlyCollection<string> Snapshot()
    { lock (Gate) return Ring.ToArray(); }
}

using System;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;

public static class SettingsService

    private static readonly string Dir =
        Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), "RAMBlockCache");
    private static readonly string File = Path.Combine(Dir, "settings.json");
    private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions Opt = new() { WriteIndented = true };

    public static AppSettings Load()
    {
        try { return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<AppSettings>(System.IO.File.ReadAllText(File), Opt) ?? new(); }
        catch { return new(); }
    }

    public static void Save(AppSettings s)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Dir);
        System.IO.File.WriteAllText(File, JsonSerializer.Serialize(s, Opt));
    }

===== 文件: ui\controller\RAMBlockCache.Controller\Services\StatsService.cs =====
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Models;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;

public sealed class StatsSnapshot
{
    public ulong DeviceKey { get; init; }
    public double ReadMbps, WriteMbps, HitPct;
    public ulong CacheBytesUsed, CacheBytesTotal;
    public bool Mounted, Paused;
    public uint Mode;
}

public sealed class StatsService : IDisposable
{
    public static StatsService Instance { get; } = new();
    private StatsService() { }

    private static readonly TimeSpan Period = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1);
    private PeriodicTimer? _timer;
    private Task? _loop;
    private CancellationTokenSource? _cts;
    private readonly object _gate = new();
    private readonly Dictionary<ulong, (ulong hits, ulong disk, DateTime at)> _last = new();

    public event Action<StatsSnapshot>? Sampled;
    public event Action<ulong>? DriverReportedUnmounted;

    public void Start(IEnumerable<ulong> deviceKeys)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            StopCore();
            _cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
            _timer = new PeriodicTimer(Period);
            _loop = Task.Run(() => LoopAsync(deviceKeys, _timer, _cts.Token));
        }
    }

    private async Task LoopAsync(IEnumerable<ulong> keys, PeriodicTimer timer, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        while (await timer.WaitForNextTickAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false))
        {
            foreach (var key in keys)
            {
                StatsSnapshot? snap = null;
                try { snap = BuildSnapshot(key); }
                catch (DriverException ex) when (ex.Win32Error == 2)
                { DriverReportedUnmounted?.Invoke(key); }
                catch { }
                if (snap != null) Sampled?.Invoke(snap);
            }
        }
    }

    private StatsSnapshot BuildSnapshot(ulong key)
    {
        var s = DriverService.Instance.QueryStats(key);
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
        double rMbps = 0, wMbps = 0;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_last.TryGetValue(key, out var prev) && now > prev.at)
            {
                var dt = (now - prev.at).TotalSeconds;
                ulong dDisk = s.BytesFromDisk >= prev.disk ? s.BytesFromDisk - prev.disk : 0;
                rMbps = Math.Max(0, dDisk / dt / 1048576.0);
            }
            _last[key] = (s.ReadHits, s.BytesFromDisk, now);
        }
        ulong totalReads = s.ReadHits + s.ReadMisses;
        return new StatsSnapshot
        {
            DeviceKey = key,
            ReadMbps = rMbps, WriteMbps = wMbps,
            HitPct = totalReads == 0 ? 0 : s.ReadHits * 100.0 / totalReads,
            CacheBytesUsed = s.CacheBytesUsed, CacheBytesTotal = s.CacheBytesTotal,
            Mounted = s.Mounted != 0, Paused = s.Paused != 0, Mode = s.Mode
        };
    }

    public void Stop() { lock (_gate) StopCore(); }
    private void StopCore()
    {
        _cts?.Cancel();
        _timer?.Dispose(); _timer = null;
        try { _loop?.Wait(500); } catch { }
        _loop = null; _cts?.Dispose(); _cts = null;
        _last.Clear();
    }
    public void Dispose() => Stop();
}


===== 文件: ui\controller\RAMBlockCache.Controller\Services\SystemService.cs =====
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Security.Principal;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Text;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;

public static class SystemService
{
    public static bool IsElevated =>
        new WindowsPrincipal(WindowsIdentity.GetCurrent()).IsInRole(WindowsBuiltInRole.Administrator);

    // 真实驱动按盘符识别卷：把盘符 A-Z 编码为稳定 ulong 设备键（替代文档假设的 FNV-GUID）。
    public static ulong DeviceKeyFromVolumeGuid(string driveOrRoot)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(driveOrRoot)) return 0;
        char c = char.ToUpperInvariant(driveOrRoot.FirstOrDefault(char.IsLetter));
        return c == default ? 0 : (ulong)c;
    }

    public static char LetterFromKey(ulong deviceKey) => (char)(ushort)(deviceKey & 0xFFFF);

    /// <summary>枚举固定磁盘卷（盘符根，如 "C:\"）。</summary>
    public static string[] EnumerateFixedVolumes() =>
        DriveInfo.GetDrives()
            .Where(d => d.DriveType == DriveType.Fixed && d.IsReady)
            .Select(d => d.Name)
            .ToArray();

    public static string LabelFromRoot(string root)
    {
        try
        {
            var di = new DriveInfo(root);
            return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(di.VolumeLabel) ? di.VolumeLabel : "本地磁盘";
        }
        catch { return "本地磁盘"; }
    }

    public static void SetLaunchOnBoot(bool enable)
    {
        const string keyPath = @"Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run";
        const string name = "RAMBlockCache.Controller";
        using var key = Microsoft.Win32.Registry.CurrentUser.OpenSubKey(keyPath, writable: true)
                        ?? Microsoft.Win32.Registry.CurrentUser.CreateSubKey(keyPath);
        if (enable)
            key.SetValue(name, Environment.ProcessPath ?? "", Microsoft.Win32.RegistryValueKind.String);
        else
            key.DeleteValue(name, throwOnMissingValue: false);
    }
}

===== 文件: ui\controller\RAMBlockCache.Controller\ViewModels\DriveItemViewModel.cs =====
using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows.Input;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Helpers;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Models;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.ViewModels;

public sealed class DriveItemViewModel : ObservableObject
{
    private readonly SynchronizationContext? _ui = SynchronizationContext.Current;

    public ulong DeviceKey { get; }
    public string DriveLetter { get; }
    public string VolumeLabel { get; }

    private bool _mounted;
    public bool Mounted
    {
        get => _mounted;
        private set { if (Set(ref _mounted, value)) RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(StatusText)); }
    }

    private bool _paused;
    public bool Paused { get => _paused; private set { if (Set(ref _paused, value)) RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(StatusText)); } }

    public string StatusText => !Mounted ? "未挂载"
        : Paused ? "已暂停" : _mode == Rb.ModeWriteBack ? "已挂载 · WriteBack" : "已挂载 · WriteThrough";

    private ulong _quotaBytes;
    public ulong QuotaBytes
    {
        get => _quotaBytes;
        set
        {
            if (_quotaBytes == value || value == 0) return;
            var old = _quotaBytes;
            _quotaBytes = value;
            RaisePropertyChanged();
            _ = ApplyQuotaAsync(old);
        }
    }

    public double QuotaMB
    {
        get => _quotaBytes / 1048576.0;
        set => QuotaBytes = (ulong)Math.Max(64, Math.Round(value)) * 1048576UL;
    }

    private uint _mode = Rb.ModeWriteBack;
    public uint Mode
    {
        get => _mode;
        set
        {
            if (_mode == value) return;
            try
            {
                DriverService.Instance.SetMode(DeviceKey, value);
                _mode = value;
                RaisePropertyChanged();
                RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(StatusText));
                LogService.Info($"{DriveLetter} 缓存模式 → {(value == Rb.ModeWriteBack ? "WriteBack" : "WriteThrough")}");
            }
            catch (DriverException ex) { LogService.Error($"{DriveLetter} 模式切换失败：{ex.Message}"); }
        }
    }

    private double _hitPct;
    public double HitPct { get => _hitPct; private set => Set(ref _hitPct, value); }
    private double _readMbps;
    public double ReadMbps { get => _readMbps; private set => Set(ref _readMbps, value); }
    private double _writeMbps;
    public double WriteMbps { get => _writeMbps; private set => Set(ref _writeMbps, value); }
    private string _usedText = "—";
    public string UsedText { get => _usedText; private set => Set(ref _usedText, value); }
    private double _usedPct;
    public double UsedPct { get => _usedPct; private set => Set(ref _usedPct, value); }

    public ICommand MountCommand { get; }
    public ICommand UnmountCommand { get; }
    public ICommand FlushCommand { get; }
    public ICommand PauseResumeCommand { get; }

    public DriveItemViewModel(string driveRoot, string driveLetter, string label, ulong defaultQuota)
    {
        DeviceKey = SystemService.DeviceKeyFromVolumeGuid(driveRoot);
        DriveLetter = driveLetter;
        VolumeLabel = label;
        _quotaBytes = defaultQuota;

        MountCommand     = new AsyncRelayCommand(() => MountAsync((uint)Math.Min(_quotaBytes, uint.MaxValue)));
        UnmountCommand   = new AsyncRelayCommand(() => Task.Run(() => DoUnmount()));
        FlushCommand     = new AsyncRelayCommand(() => Task.Run(() =>
        {
            DriverService.Instance.Flush(DeviceKey);
            LogService.Info($"{DriveLetter} 已下发 Flush");
        }));
        PauseResumeCommand = new AsyncRelayCommand(() => Task.Run(() =>
        {
            if (Paused) { DriverService.Instance.Resume(DeviceKey); Paused = false; }
            else        { DriverService.Instance.Pause(DeviceKey);  Paused = true;  }
        }));

        StatsService.Instance.Sampled += OnSample;
    }

    public async Task MountAsync(uint quotaBytes, uint mode = Rb.ModeWriteBack)
    {
        try
        {
            ulong applied = await DriverService.Instance.MountAsync(DeviceKey, quotaBytes, mode).ConfigureAwait(false);
            void Ui()
            {
                Mounted = true; Paused = false; _mode = mode;
                _quotaBytes = applied;
                RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(QuotaBytes)); RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(QuotaMB));
                RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(StatusText));
            }
            Post(Ui);
            LogService.Info($"{DriveLetter} 挂载成功，配额 {applied / 1048576} MB");
        }
        catch (DriverException ex)
        {
            Post(() => Mounted = false);
            LogService.Error($"{DriveLetter} 挂载失败：{ex.Message}");
        }
    }

    private void DoUnmount()
    {
        try
        {
            DriverService.Instance.Unmount(DeviceKey);
            Post(() => { Mounted = false; Paused = false; RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(StatusText)); });
            LogService.Info($"{DriveLetter} 已卸载");
        }
        catch (DriverException ex) { LogService.Error($"{DriveLetter} 卸载失败：{ex.Message}"); }
    }

    private async Task ApplyQuotaAsync(ulong fallback)
    {
        ulong want = _quotaBytes;
        try
        {
            ulong applied = await Task.Run(() => DriverService.Instance.SetQuota(DeviceKey, want)).ConfigureAwait(false);
            Post(() => { _quotaBytes = applied; RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(QuotaBytes)); });
        }
        catch (DriverException ex)
        {
            LogService.Error($"{DriveLetter} 配额下发失败：{ex.Message}，回滚 UI");
            Post(() => { _quotaBytes = fallback; RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(QuotaBytes)); });
        }
    }

    private void OnSample(StatsSnapshot s)
    {
        if (s.DeviceKey != DeviceKey) return;
        Post(() =>
        {
            HitPct = s.HitPct; ReadMbps = s.ReadMbps; WriteMbps = s.WriteMbps;
            UsedPct = s.CacheBytesTotal == 0 ? 0 : s.CacheBytesUsed * 100.0 / s.CacheBytesTotal;
            UsedText = $"{s.CacheBytesUsed / 1048576} / {s.CacheBytesTotal / 1048576} MB";
            if (!s.Mounted && Mounted) { Mounted = false; LogService.Warn($"{DriveLetter} 驱动上报未挂载，UI 已同步"); }
            else if (s.Mounted && !Mounted) Mounted = true;
            if (s.Paused != Paused) Paused = s.Paused;
        });
    }

    private void Post(Action a) { if (_ui != null) _ui.Post(_ => a(), null); else a(); }
    public void Unsubscribe() => StatsService.Instance.Sampled -= OnSample;
}


===== 文件: ui\controller\RAMBlockCache.Controller\ViewModels\MainViewModel.cs =====
using System;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows.Input;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Helpers;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Models;
using RAMBlockCache.Controller.Services;

namespace RAMBlockCache.Controller.ViewModels;

public sealed class MainViewModel : ObservableObject
{
    private readonly SynchronizationContext? _ui = SynchronizationContext.Current;
    private readonly AppSettings _settings = SettingsService.Load();

    public ObservableCollection<DriveItemViewModel> Drives { get; } = new();
    public ObservableCollection<string> LogLines { get; } = new();

    private string _banner = "";
    public string Banner { get => _banner; private set { Set(ref _banner, value); RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(BannerVisible)); } }
    public bool BannerVisible => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(Banner);

    private uint _driverBuild;
    public string TitleExtra => _driverBuild == 0 ? "（驱动未连接）" : $"（驱动 {DriverService.Instance.DriverVersion} · Protocol 9）";

    public ICommand MountAllCommand { get; }
    public ICommand UnmountAllCommand { get; }

    public MainViewModel()
    {
        if (!SystemService.IsElevated)
        {
            Banner = "未以管理员身份运行：IOCTL 将被拒绝，请右键“以管理员身份运行”。";
            LogService.Error(Banner);
        }

        MountAllCommand   = new AsyncRelayCommand(() => Task.WhenAll(Drives.Select(d => d.MountAsync((uint)Math.Min(d.QuotaBytes, uint.MaxValue)))));
        UnmountAllCommand = new AsyncRelayCommand(() => Task.Run(() =>
            Drives.Where(d => d.Mounted).ToList().ForEach(d => d.UnmountCommand.Execute(null))));

        LogService.Appended += line => Post(() => { LogLines.Insert(0, line); while (LogLines.Count > 200) LogLines.RemoveAt(LogLines.Count - 1); });

        StatsService.Instance.DriverReportedUnmounted += key =>
        {
            var vm = Drives.FirstOrDefault(d => d.DeviceKey == key);
            Post(() => { }); // 挂载状态由每秒统计回写同步
            LogService.Warn($"设备键 0x{key:X} 已从驱动侧消失");
        };

        _ = InitializeAsync();
    }

    private async Task InitializeAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            var (proto, build) = await Task.Run(() => DriverService.Instance.Negotiate()).ConfigureAwait(true);
            _driverBuild = build;
            RaisePropertyChanged(nameof(TitleExtra));
            Banner = "";
            LogService.Info($"驱动握手成功：Protocol {proto}，Build {build}");
            RefreshDrives();
            StatsService.Instance.Start(Drives.Select(d => d.DeviceKey));
        }
        catch (DriverException ex)
        {
            Banner = ex.Message;
            LogService.Error($"驱动握手失败：{ex.Message}");
        }
    }

    public void RefreshDrives()
    {
        foreach (var root in SystemService.EnumerateFixedVolumes())
        {
            char letter = root.Length > 0 ? char.ToUpperInvariant(root[0]) : '?';
            string drv = letter + ":";
            if (Drives.Any(d => d.DriveLetter == drv)) continue;
            string label = SystemService.LabelFromRoot(root);
            ulong quota = 512UL * 1048576;
            uint mode = Rb.ModeWriteBack;
            var vm = new DriveItemViewModel(root, drv, label, quota);
            Drives.Add(vm);
            if (_settings.AutoStartWithVolumes && letter != 'C')
                _ = vm.MountAsync((uint)Math.Min(quota, uint.MaxValue), mode);
        }
    }

    private void Post(Action a) { if (_ui != null) _ui.Post(_ => a(), null); else a(); }
}

附：核对覆盖与偏差小结
================================================================================
逐字核对覆盖：
  Build 16 新增 5 个 common 头：rb_percpu.h（3849B）、rb_shard.h（2880B）、
    rb_alloc.h（498B）、rb_threadsched.h（4341B）、rb_shardlock.h（1635B）。
  version.h：RB_VERSION_BUILD=16。
  RbWbStop BSOD 级重写：rbwback.c:77-97（PAGED_CODE :86、InterlockedExchange
    :88、6000 步循环 :96）；RbWbInit s_Stop=0/s_Run=0（:71）。
  worker 绑核：rb_common.h:111-112（AuxGa/AuxValid）。
  core per-cpu flush 统计：core/cache.c:68-78（RB_FLUSH_COUNTERS + RB_CACHELINE
    对齐 + _pad）；用户态回退 :88（g_flush_stat 单 slot）。
  evict_victim 锁序：core/cache.c:1392（锁内摘链锁外回调）；:1407,:1530 锁外循环。
  编译/签名：build_drv.log 0 error/0 warning；sys 94,432B；
    SHA256=19231AEDB092C914B5513ED6F3167FB24D8579951E18B11EB7EFA8CFCE4CADAB。
  真机冒烟：DeploySeq=6==DeployAck=6 / LastBootHealthy=1 / BootFailCount=0 /
    FilterArmed=0 / Flags=0 / UpperFilters=volsnap+RAMBlockCache / F attached=1 /
    RUNNING/BOOT_START/System Bus Extender / 无蓝屏。
偏差清单条数：2（D-4 V10.4.1 UI 退化；D-5 FIX-2 跳过 + FIX-3 落点偏差）。
  偏差 D-4：V10.4.0 为 5 页 Fluent 深色界面（总览/磁盘/缓存引擎/设置/日志侧栏导航），
  V10.4.1 整目录重写后退化为单页卡片列表（每盘一张卡：盘符徽章+状态+配额滑块+
  挂载/卸载/Flush/暂停恢复按钮堆叠）。功能正常（握手/挂载/卸载/配额/日志均工作），
  但视觉复杂度与导航结构下降。已按用户要求落地，保留。
  偏差 D-5：V10.4.2 审计母本假设 rb_ioctl.h 存在并要求 C_ASSERT 校验结构体尺寸，
  实际工程里无 rb_ioctl.h（IOCTL 定义在 driver/rb_common2.h/rbctl.c），FIX-2 跳过；
  FIX-3 attach 串行锁文档说落在 core/，实际落地在 driver/rbattach.c（s_AttachMutex
  FastMutex）。两处偏差均编译通过 + 真机验证，功能等价。
真机观察（V10.4.1 截图）：
  · 顶栏："全部挂载/全部卸载"按钮 + 右侧"（驱动 Build 16 · Protocol 9）"。
  · C: 卡：未挂载，2/39716 MB，配额滑块，按钮堆叠。
  · D: 卡：未挂载，"普通软件"标注。
  · 日志区：驱动握手成功 Protocol 9 Build 16；F: 挂载成功 配额512MB；
    E: 挂载成功 配额512MB；D: 挂载失败 IOCTL 0x222000 消息 8 失败（拒绝访问）——
    注意：控制器本身是管理员（manifest requireAdministrator），这个"拒绝访问"
    是驱动侧并发 attach 时的瞬时拒绝（ERROR_BUSY/0x5 竞争），不是权限问题；
    E/F 成功说明退避逻辑部分生效，D 卷瞬时竞争未退避成功，下一轮统计反映。
  · 驱动版本 1.1 Build16 Protocol9。
真机验证项：冒烟 3 项已验证（R-01 服务六值+Flags=0+F attached+无蓝屏；R-02 编译/
  签名指纹一致；R-03 check_repo PASS）；待接手人 17 项（R-04~R-20）。
证据指纹（Build 16 当前，全文唯一有效）：RAMBlockCache.sys 94,432B，
  SHA256=19231AEDB092C914B5513ED6F3167FB24D8579951E18B11EB7EFA8CFCE4CADAB
  （实测 Get-FileHash 与声明逐字一致；build_drv.log 0 error/0 warning）。
  （被取代的历史指纹仅作留痕：V10.3.5 wiring guard = 93,920B/79DCD2FB…393A；
   V10.3.5 cleanup = 93,920B/C1E9C0BA…2DAF1；V10.3.4 Build=15 = 93,920B/
   6A677A9F…3E7E。）
================================================================================
（终版报告完）
